propositions: The completion-verify agent step has no forced-landing boundary: RunRequest.tool_step_limit is never set, so budget exhaustion kills the run with no verdict instead of landing one.

Three of four real gate runs looped on repetitive tool calls (40-70% redundant), yet the existing max_consecutive_repeat metric is blind to cycles of length >= 2 and scores pathological runs below healthy ones.
A windowed distinct-ratio (window 24 calls, trip <= 0.50) separates pathological loops from healthy breadth with a 5x margin and catches all three real loops while never firing on clean runs.

The shipped tool_step_limit landing mechanism (agent_call.py:64-73) is only armed by the bounded-recovery sub-call; wiring it to the primary verify step or applying the tool-free steering actuator enables verdicts on incomplete evidence rather than unattested force-closes.
